title: World tree myth of survivors climbing into the heavens

tellings.quote: Some of the stories like for example the the world tree where the great catastrophe comes and human humanity climbs the world tree

plain: Many old myths around the world tell of a world tree: a great catastrophe comes, and humanity survives by climbing the tree up into the heavens. A researcher of ancient catastrophes named Randall Carlson brings up the motif in passing, without naming a source. He offers it as one of the stories that may hold a memory of a real disaster in the deep past.
